params.caption: 🎮 Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sells 5.2 million in four days Nintendo says the Ocarina of Time remake moved more than 5.2 million copies in its first four days, making it the fastest-selling Switch 2 game ever. In under a week it has already outsold Zelda entries such as A Link Between Worlds and Echoes of Wisdom. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 12:31 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #Zelda #NintendoSwitch2 #GamingNews
